item.title: Bonnaroo releases 2026 lineup with Skrillex, The Strokes, and Noah Kahan headlining
item.description: MANCHESTER, TN. (ABC36 NEWS NOW) – Bonnaroo has unveiled its 2026 festival lineup, marking a major return after last year’s cancellation due to severe flooding. Headliners for the four-day event include Skrillex, The Strokes, and Noah Kahan, with additional performances scheduled from Kesha, Vince Staples, Yungblud, and many more artists.
